_notes: Children of Blood (small campaign, 3 scenarios + the Friends in Low Places interlude). Log entries name only the front-loaded NPCs (Julia Stern, Zburamoarte) and the campaign title, so nothing is blurred. Achievement scenario ties follow where ArkhamCards records each event: Fang of Zburamoarte is added in River of Blood, Forged Permit / Sanguine Song in New Horizons, Chosen of Zburamoarte in Blood Money. Charlie Kane joins during the interlude right before Blood Money (and is used there), so thanks_for_your_vote is tied to blood_money. Campaign completion = either Blood Money ending outcome is recorded (left_to_the_cults_mercy is a New Horizons note, not a campaign end). its_part_of_my_backstory stays manual: there is no investigator inference.

outcomes._notes: Proposed by tools/outcomes.mjs. failed_to_stop_the_children_of_blood is left out: Blood Money R2 records it and still wins the campaign, while no resolution records it and loses.

scenarioResolutionOutcomes._notes: Per-scenario Succeed/Failed. River of Blood R3: Julia escapes for good, a loss. New Horizons R1 leaves the facility with the search unfinished, a voluntary early exit like a resignation, so neutral; R4 is overwhelmed by the cult. Blood Money R2 fails to stop the Children of Blood (the campaign is still won), so the scenario is a loss; no resolution is each surviving investigator resigning.

blood_money.label: At least 1 investigator has The Blood Blight weakness in their deck
blood_money._note: Blood Money R1 and R2 check ArkhamCards' has_card condition on The Blood Blight (13118) after the experience step; a yes earns the Chosen of Zburamoarte campaign reward card (13093a) and the And All I Got Were These Bloody Fangs achievement. The label is the branch text (05_blood_money.json check_chosen_of_zburamoarte) without its leading 'If'. Deck contents are not in the log, hence an Extra.
